name: site-footer
title: Site footer
description: The page's contentinfo: grouped link columns, brand and legal line, optional newsletter-signup.

frame.summary: Full-bleed band with a top rule; link groups in an intrinsic grid; legal line below.

regions.name: brand
regions.purpose: Logo, one-line description, optional newsletter-signup block.

regions.name: link-groups
regions.collapse: auto-fill grid; groups never collapse into disclosures (links stay one tab away).

components.name: divider
components.for: Rule between groups and legal line.

dependsOnFuture.for: The rule above the legal line.

groups.type: Array<{ label: string; links: Array<{ label: string; href: string }> }>

label.summary: Accessible name of the footer nav.
label.a11y: Must differ from TopNav's and SideNav's labels.

behavior.summary: Static. Group labels name their lists the way SideNav's section labels do.

decisions.why: SideNav's reasoning: a footer cannot know its heading level, and five h2s at the bottom of every page pollute the outline. Each list is aria-labelledby its label instead.

decisions.decision: It renders <footer> and is the contentinfo landmark
decisions.why: Like TopNav renders <header> as the banner; a page has exactly one, and the template places it outside <main>.

decisions.decision: Groups never become disclosures on narrow screens
decisions.why: Hiding links behind a toggle costs a tap per group for no gain; a two-column grid of short lists fits a phone.

obligations: Place outside <main> so the footer is contentinfo.
If newsletter-signup is included its heading level is the caller's; 2 is usual.

steps.change: Brand above a two-column grid of groups; legal line stacks.
Brand beside groups; legal in one row.

native.reason: Native apps have no page footer; legal and about links live in a settings/about screen (see the settings template).

tokenGaps.need: A page content max-inline-size (container width) for marketing bands
tokenGaps.interim: The band's content box is capped at calc(var(--rata-size-control-lg) * 32) and centred with auto inline margins; the playground's own column cap is a literal with a comment saying there is no measure token. Open decision: a size.container.* role via the design-tokens skill, or keep deriving from the control scale.

tokenGaps.need: A grid gutter role (column and row gap between tiles)
tokenGaps.interim: gap: var(--rata-space-gap-lg) between tiles, var(--rata-space-stack-lg) between rows when they wrap. space.gap.* is documented for inline items, not grid gutters.
